frozenComposition.semanticOperation: trim external neutral canvas while preserving all three hinge representations and RETA/CURVA/SUPER CURVA annotations

interpretation: The 8x cubic path preserves the three-piece visual group and its semantic annotations without visible ringing or label loss.
The placement-scale difference from the 4x baseline is negligible in this preserve-orientation case.
This reinforces the distinction between renderer safety and renderer necessity: a profile may be safe but still not justify its extra cost.
Annotation preservation remains an independent semantic requirement and must not be traded for a marginal raster-quality gain.
decision: Keep the higher-order sampler available for transformed cases, but do not require 8x for this mild preserve-orientation table/card-like presentation.
